parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: DeploySchema
parameters.description: The deployment status of the cluster.

parameters.name: ScaleMax
parameters.description: The maximum capacity for auto scaling.

parameters.name: ScaleMin
parameters.description: The minimum capacity for auto scaling.
